name: codex-subagent-router
description: AI model routing for Codex subagents. Let Jev choose the model and reasoning effort for each mission, using your own task profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Describe the mission. Let Jev pick the model.
interface.longDescription: Route native Codex subagents to a model and reasoning effort using Jev and your own JSON task profiles. A PreToolUse hook handles selection; explicit settings take precedence, and unavailable routing keeps native defaults.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this task using the configured subagent routing profiles.
